Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent sprite sheet for a German language learning app. Reference image is STYLE ONLY; ignore all UI, text and buttons. Draw SIX separate isolated illustrations in a precise THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, equal square cells, very generous transparent gutters and outer margins. No cell borders, no background, no words, no letters, no numbers, no labels. Playful flat vector-looking cartoons matching reference: thick organic navy #102B50 outlines, orange #FF5726, white #FFFFFF, cream #FFF1E5 ONLY. No other colors, gradients, shadows, texture. Simple friendly children, restrained detail, two small tapered orange/navy accent dashes per scene. Every scene must be self-contained, centered, wholly within its cell, no touching neighbors.
Panel subjects in READING ORDER, maintain these identities across sheet:
1 I: single spiky-haired boy performing action, one hand pointing to his own chest.
2 YOU singular: one ponytailed girl performing action, looking directly at viewer, tiny pointing hand entering foreground aimed at her.
3 HE: single spiky-haired boy performing action, three-quarter side view looking at action, NO extra person.
4 SHE: single ponytailed girl performing action, three-quarter side view looking at action, NO extra person.
5 WE: boy and girl BOTH performing action TOGETHER; boy gestures towards own chest, both cheerful.
6 YOU plural: TWO children BOTH performing action, face viewer, tiny foreground pointing hand addresses the GROUP.
Action must be unmistakable and primary. All panels same visual scale; group panels fit comfortably.
ACTION FOR ALL SIX PANELS: STUDYING: each subject reads an open book at a very simple desk. In group panels TWO open books and two learners; NOT one student watched by another.
